assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, building surveys and engineering constraints require official or professionally cleared evidence before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is reviewable as concept content, while statutory controls and professional scoring remain pending.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All location, area and ratio outputs must be recomputed when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Community issue #846 records a location conflict between the provisional overall polygon and an OSM-mapped heritage park.
assumptions.impact: The proposal avoids parcel-level or exact heritage-location claims and treats the corridor diagram as a replaceable hypothesis.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, ownership, building condition, utilities, heritage controls, FAR and height limits are not available as cleared official files.
assumptions.impact: Routes, programme envelopes, phasing and retain-renovate-demolish logic remain conceptual.

assumptions.statement: Every proposed AI scenario is designed with an identified human duty role, a non-AI alternative and a stop threshold.
assumptions.impact: The 100% coverage metrics audit protocol completeness, not real-world service quality.

assumptions.statement: External cases are used only to extract governance and operating mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: No foreign programme scale, budget, statutory arrangement or performance result is transferred to Beijing.

assumptions.statement: Shenzhen and Chongqing are method references subordinate to the repository brief and Beijing site conditions.
assumptions.impact: The proposal borrows scenario-led innovation, legible service interfaces, continuous walking experience and closed-loop operations, but does not copy skyline, density, mountain morphology, branded imagery, budgets or performance claims.

assumptions.statement: Technology readiness is classified by deployment conditions rather than novelty.
assumptions.impact: Nine scenarios may enter procurement and site verification now; three remain controlled pilots; four high-risk capabilities are excluded from the base scheme.
